name: Prince Martin
source:
A Prince of the Lusanti Kingdom. He is often referred to as the heir to the kingdom erroneously. The MC is overshadowed by his [url=https://vndb.org/c165638]brother[/url] and often suffers the rage of his [url=https://vndb.org/c165578]father[/url], the King. This has given way to the MC having self-esteem issues.
